mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact commutator defects, padded operator words on every retained basis vector, cubic witnesses, falling-basis transport and coefficient norms, and prime-field quotient controls in the declared finite range.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q with exact fractions.Fraction; integer modular arithmetic over F_p for p in {2,3,5,7}
mathematics.conventions: Increasing monomial degree; words act right to left; padded matrices retain N plus the maximum positive degree excursion; final output is projected to degree N. Field quotients are modulo z^p.
inputs: D differentiation, M multiplication by the variable followed by the stated cutoff
Displayed degree-three falling-basis matrix C and its inverse
All D/M words in the declared length range; all retained basis vectors; every quotient basis-product pair at the declared primes
non_claims: Finite checks do not prove all-word or all-characteristic statements; elementary arguments are supplied separately in the text.
No floating tolerance, random sampling, new Lean result or infinite-dimensional operator-domain claim.
